legal_entity_name: President and Fellows of Harvard College
eligible_categories: Temporary academic appointments. "Visa sponsorship is generally available for international scholars who hold temporary academic appointments, and who engage in scholarly activities including teaching and/or research at the University or its affiliated hospitals." Scholars are defined as people with academic appointments "such as research fellows, visiting scholars, postdoctoral fellows, instructors, faculty, and student interns".
exclusions: "University visa sponsorship is generally not available for non-academic staff positions." Only "in exceptional circumstances" for "high level administrative and staff positions". People in administrative or staff positions on OPT, STEM OPT or Academic Training "will not be eligible for Harvard-sponsored visas" when it ends and "will be limited to working only until the end" of it.
fellowship_rule: Excluded from H-1B: "Individuals receiving fellowship income or those holding unpaid Harvard appointments are not eligible for H-1B visa status since fellowship is not considered remuneration for services provided to the University."
j1_default: not stated as a default on the pages read
fee_payer: not stated on the pages read
policy_quote: The University generally provides visa sponsorship only for researchers and faculty members. University visa sponsorship is generally not available for non-academic staff positions.

eligible_categories: Faculty, scholars and staff whose job is a specialty occupation. Staff are named explicitly: "Some foreign nationals academic departments occupy staff roles that may require H-1B sponsorship. Examples of such roles are Research Technician, Research Associate, Research Specialist." Administrative departments "may also sponsor" staff roles; the role must require a bachelor's degree in a specific field and meet Department of Labor salary requirements.
exclusions: "not all staff positions qualify for H-1B sponsorship". "J-1 Exchange Visitors cannot hold staff positions." People subject to the J-1 two-year home residence requirement are not eligible until it is fulfilled or waived.
j1_default: not stated. Related timing rule: "Brandeis expects employees eligible for F-1 OPT and STEM OPT to first maximize their time in F-1 status before becoming eligible for H-1B sponsorship."
